# `enrichers/architect.ts`

Module overview: This module implements the **architect enricher**, which calls Claude to produce a structured `ArchitectBlueprint` for a given task. It handles prompt construction, Claude response parsing (with a JSON-first / raw-text fallback strategy), and exposes a ready-to-use `Enricher` instance.

## Interfaces

### `ArchitectMilestone`

Represents a single milestone within a medium or large task blueprint.

```ts
interface ArchitectMilestone {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  filesToModify: string[];
  acceptanceCriteria: string[];
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | Short name for the milestone. |
| `description` | `string` | Detailed description of what this milestone covers. |
| `filesToModify` | `string[]` | List of file paths expected to be changed in this milestone. |
| `acceptanceCriteria` | `string[]` | Conditions that must be met for the milestone to be considered complete. |

---

### `ArchitectBlueprint`

The structured output produced by the architect enricher for a task.

```ts
interface ArchitectBlueprint {
  approach: string;
  keyFiles?: string[];
  checklist?: string[];
  milestones?: ArchitectMilestone[];
  clarificationQuestions?: string[];
  awaitingInput?: boolean;
  skipped?: boolean;
  skipPreview?: boolean;
}
```

| Member | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `approach` | `string` | ✅ | High-level implementation strategy. |
| `keyFiles` | `string[]` | ❌ | Key files for small tasks (no milestones). |
| `checklist` | `string[]` | ❌ | Checklist for small tasks (no milestones). |
| `milestones` | `ArchitectMilestone[]` | ❌ | Milestones for medium/large tasks. |
| `clarificationQuestions` | `string[]` | ❌ | Set when the architect needs user input before producing a blueprint. |
| `awaitingInput` | `boolean` | ❌ | `true` when clarification was requested and answers are still pending. |
| `skipped` | `boolean` | ❌ | `true` when the enricher was skipped because the task is trivial. |
| `skipPreview` | `boolean` | ❌ | `true` when the task has no user-facing output and the preview step can be skipped. |

## Functions

### `parseBlueprint`

```ts
import { parseBlueprint } from '...';

function parseBlueprint(raw: string, hasAnswers?: boolean): ArchitectBlueprint
```

Parses the raw Claude output string into an `ArchitectBlueprint`.

Attempts JSON parsing first (after stripping any markdown code fences). If JSON parsing fails, falls back to storing the raw text in the `approach` field so that downstream consumers still have something to work with.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw` | `string` | ✅ | The raw string returned by Claude. |
| `hasAnswers` | `boolean` | ❌ | Whether clarification answers have already been provided. |

#### Returns

`ArchitectBlueprint` — The parsed blueprint, or a minimal blueprint with `approach` set to the raw text on parse failure.

#### Example

```ts
import { parseBlueprint } from '...';

const blueprint = parseBlueprint(claudeResponse, true);
console.log(blueprint.approach);
```

### `stripCodeFences`

> ⚠️ This function is **not a named export**. It is an internal helper.

```ts
function stripCodeFences(text: string): string
```

Strips markdown code fences (e.g., ` ```json ... ``` `) from a Claude response, then attempts to parse the result as JSON. Returns the parsed object or `null` on failure.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | ✅ | Raw text that may contain markdown code fences. |

#### Returns

`string` — The text with code fences removed.

### `buildUserPrompt`

> ⚠️ This function is **not a named export**. It is an internal helper.

```ts
function buildUserPrompt(
  task: TaskRow,
  priorResults: Record<string, unknown>,
  clarificationAnswers?: string[],
  clarificationQuestions?: string[],
  learningsStr?: string
): string
```

Builds the user prompt that is sent to Claude alongside the architect system prompt.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | `TaskRow` | ✅ | The task record to generate a blueprint for. |
| `priorResults` | `Record<string, unknown>` | ✅ | Results from previously run enrichers, made available as context. |
| `clarificationAnswers` | `string[]` | ❌ | User-supplied answers to prior clarification questions. |
| `clarificationQuestions` | `string[]` | ❌ | The clarification questions that were previously asked. |
| `learningsStr` | `string` | ❌ | A string of prior learnings to include as additional context. |

#### Returns

`string` — The fully constructed user prompt string.

## Constants

### `architectEnricher`

```ts
import { architectEnricher } from '...';
```

**Type:** `Enricher`

A pre-configured `Enricher` instance that runs the architect enrichment step. Pass this to your enrichment pipeline to have Claude generate an `ArchitectBlueprint` for each task.

#### Example

```ts
import { architectEnricher } from '...';

const result = await architectEnricher.run(task, context);
```
